name: [CLANS] Skibidi Battlegrounds
desc:
Update just released, find the update log in game!

👍 Like the game if you enjoyed it!
💎 Use code "SKIBIDI" in-game to get some free gems!

📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)

🖥️ Controls
Left Click - Punch
G - Awakening
1-4 - Skills
Q - Dash
F - Block

You can disable morphs in settings
